summary: Full backend + frontend test of Component Detector. All 8 pytest backend tests and full Playwright UI flow pass (upload -> real gpt-5.4 vision analysis -> edit -> save -> history reload -> delete). AI correctly identified an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 GPU from an Unsplash image with confidence 'Élevée' and price '180 - 300 €'. Footer credit exact. Fixed one critical serialization bug: backend was returning MongoDB alias '_id' instead of 'id' which would have broken every frontend action (edit/save/delete/history-item key). Added response_model_by_alias=False to POST /api/analyze, GET /api/history, PUT /api/analysis/{id}.

minor.issue: Returns 200 with {success:true} even if id does not exist. Consider 404 for missing docs.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: return 404 on DELETE when id not found. Optional: consider narrowing CORS_ORIGINS from '*'.
critical_code_review_comments: Model Analysis stores id under alias '_id'; FastAPI response_model serialized with by_alias=True by default, so responses shipped '_id' instead of 'id'. Frontend uses item.id everywhere - would have completely broken the app. Fix applied: response_model_by_alias=False on 3 endpoints.

POST /api/analyze embeds the full base64 image inside the Mongo document AND returns it in every /api/history entry (up to 200 items). This will bloat responses fast. Consider returning a thumbnail or an image_url; store image on disk / bucket.

logger is defined AFTER it is used inside the analyze() except block (logger.exception). If an exception happens before basicConfig runs at module import order, this could NameError. Order: define logger before route definitions.

_extract_json regex `re.search(r"```(?:json)?\s*(\{.*?\})\s*```", ..., re.DOTALL)` uses non-greedy on the JSON body inside fences - can truncate large nested JSON. Consider greedy or a stack-based parser.
No pagination on /api/history (hardcoded 200). Fine for MVP but note it.
seed_data_creation: Downloaded a real CPU/GPU photo to /app/test_fixtures/cpu.jpg (Unsplash CPU photo, 800x533 JPEG). Used by pytest + playwright.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real AI call to gpt-5.4 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY works and returns valid French JSON. Fixture at /app/test_fixtures/cpu.jpg. Backend model previously mis-serialized id; verify response includes 'id' string key before running UI. Frontend URL: https://component-detector-3.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the id/_id bug: Pydantic v2 model Analysis declares `id: Optional[PyObjectId] = Field(default=None, alias='_id')`. FastAPI's default response_model_by_alias=True made all responses ship the field as '_id'. Frontend code (Home.jsx: onSave(item.id,...), key={item.id}, axios PUT `${API}/analysis/${id}`) expects 'id'. Without the fix every save/delete/history click would call /api/analysis/undefined -> 400. Mitigation: added response_model_by_alias=False on analyze, history, update endpoints. Verified by curl and 8/8 pytest.
